facts.text: Sam expressed sympathy for Evan's job loss and offered support.

evidence.quote: Sorry about your job, Evan. It's tough when it comes out of nowhere, but I'm proud of how you're handling it.
Thanks, Sam. Your support means a lot.

facts.text: Evan acknowledged Sam's support and mentioned he is currently seeking a new job.

evidence.quote: It's been quite a ride, but I really appreciate having someone like you to talk to. I'll definitely reach out if I need anything.
The company downsized, and I was part of that. I'm currently on the hunt for a new job, which hasn't been easy, but I'm keeping my spirits up and staying hopeful.

facts.text: Sam encouraged Evan to stay positive and assured him of continued support.

evidence.quote: Life can be tough sometimes, but we got this. Stay positive and it'll all work out. Just know that I'm here if you need someone to talk to.

facts.text: Evan thanked Sam for his kind words and support, and mentioned he would stay positive and keep going.

evidence.quote: Thanks, Sam. Your kind words and support mean a lot. It's great to have you here. I'm gonna stay positive and keep going.
